purpose: Read the service-account IAM policies of existing project Owner/Project-IAM-Admin candidates and compare their roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser members with the exact members already authorizing the canonical superior-logic-deployer. Identify whether any existing admin service account directly trusts the same GitHub WIF principal, so a keyless direct-auth route can be tested without granting the deployer broader authority.
truth_boundary: Read-only direct-WIF trust census only. Do not alter IAM, service accounts, WIF configuration or keys; do not access secret payloads, run Gemini inference, build or deploy images, change Cloud Run traffic, send communications, publish, spend, or perform destructive actions. A policy-member match only qualifies a direct-auth candidate; it does not by itself prove successful authentication or authorize mutation.
